# VonSchelling Limited

> Kenyan agricultural export company serving international trade buyers. This reference points to public company and buyer information; it is not a live inventory, quotation or compliance certificate.

## Green Coffee Beans

- Washed Kenyan Arabica: AA, AB, PB, C and specialty micro-lots.
- Origins discussed: Nyeri, Kirinyaga, Murang'a, Kiambu, Embu and Meru.
- Varieties discussed: SL28, SL34, Ruiru 11 and Batian.
- Export moisture target: 10% to 11%, verified for the selected lot. Water activity is a separate measurement.
- Sourcing includes Nairobi Coffee Exchange auction purchases, especially for volume requirements, alongside direct estate channels. Available records are confirmed per lot.
- Sample availability, grade, crop, volume, cup results, packing, price and shipment terms are confirmed in each offer. No universal cup score, certification or EUDR compliance is asserted.
- Mizizi roasted coffee and private-label coffee are separate finished-coffee offerings. Private-label minimum order quantity begins at 1,000 kg per roast profile.

## Company and procurement

- [Coffee offerings](https://www.vonschelling.co.ke/coffee): Green export specifications, sample approval, packing and finished coffee.
- [About](https://www.vonschelling.co.ke/about): Company overview.
- [Quality and traceability](https://www.vonschelling.co.ke/quality): Lot-specific quality and evidence.
- [Export and logistics](https://www.vonschelling.co.ke/export-logistics): Shipment planning and commercial terms.
- [Sustainability](https://www.vonschelling.co.ke/sustainability): Sourcing and due diligence context.
- [Contact](https://www.vonschelling.co.ke/contact): Enquiry forms prepare an email draft; the buyer must send it to reach the team. No enquiry is submitted or stored by the form.
